## Activity

During August 2019, Market Eye Clinic completed 38 captures. This activity represents the total number of image captures recorded for the month. The reported activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 38 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.3 per cent. These captures could not be used for grading and are included in the monthly image quality result. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 7 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This indicates that the midpoint grading lag for the month was 1 day. The activity, image quality and grading results are reported for Market Eye Clinic for August 2019.
